title: Sliding-Window Streaming VLMs: Full Evaluation — Qwen3.8-27B vs Muse Glimmer 30B
summary: Qwen3.8-27B and Muse Glimmer 30B run as causal online assistants (an 8-frame sliding window plus a memory they write themselves, replayed in media time) on the Wearable AI validation split (all 2,100 sessions, with the official starter-kit protocol and, for EgoProactive, also the Pro2Bench paper protocol) and on Ego-MC-Bench (39 videos) under the Ego-MC-Bench paper's own evaluation protocol and official evaluator. Only the model's view (window plus memory) differs from each benchmark's protocol. An isolated latency study compares both models with and without reasoning.

title: Human–Device Simulation — a rigged human operating five household devices from English action sentences (3D render + MuJoCo contact)
summary: Reproducible 3D pipeline: a clothed MPFB human with IK-driven hands operates a CC BY 4.0 microwave model and a generic desktop printer in Blender; each device's key (microwave START, printer OK) is driven by MuJoCo contact against a kinematic fingertip proxy with a negative control; door, knob, bowl, paper tray and paper stack use labelled assisted grasps; the turntable, interior light, display and printed sheet are labelled motor or illustrative effects. Two recorded runs (microwave 51 s, printer 35 s) rendered from external, first-person and hand-detail cameras (preview quality). 2026-10-11: three procedural devices built from reference videos (Samsung-style microwave with 21 contact keys, Breville-style espresso machine, Frigidaire-style induction range with a touch panel), four tasks each, all rendered from three cameras; the old microwave runs stay on the page. 2026-10-12: induction range rebuilt with 4 knobs and 12 contact-tested keys; every display shows authored per-step states. 2026-10-14: a semantic action layer — parameterized action families with grounded arguments ("open the microwave door to 37 %", "set the knob controlling the rear-right zone to level 7", "move the saucepan onto the front zone on my left") — executed 14 programs of English sentences through the same pipeline; ambiguous or impossible requests are refused with a reason. New page: Action families.
